Read `{{skillPath}}` inside source first: it is the canonical skill; the Codex entrypoint references that same skill. Read source/AGENTS.md and the scoped source instructions.

## Authority and baseline

Implement the approved prototype inside this package, not the original framework checkout or a personal vault. Do not commit, push, publish, activate a plugin, access providers or overwrite existing packages without separate authorization. Mode: {{mode}}. For new-feature/improvement work inspect baseline.project.json and the source revision in the brief; preserve all unrelated stable IDs, data, pages, library revisions, scenarios and behavior. A full project export is not automatically a safe feature merge.

{{brief}}

## Implementation

The generated source is a starting scaffold, NOT a completed prototype. Inspect source/design/compiler-origins.json, generated visual definitions, acceptance TODOs and compiler-readiness.json. Keep one Companion project format: companion.project.json is the complete v6 import/compiler input; package metadata must never be inserted into its closed envelope. Update source/design/project.json and the package's companion.project.json consistently. Generated page/component instances already have stable IDs. Titles were the only creation fields; defaults and unfinished interactions remain explicit.

Use real TypeScript, Vue 3 SFCs, Pinia and Nuxt UI components. Preserve the shared compiler/runtime seams and repository architecture; no HTML pretending to be Vue, no Nuxt framework, no CDN, runtime remote imports or external fonts. Do not add an app shell to an editor-only brief. Implement every agreed visible action, its failure, cancellation, recovery and focus behavior. Simulations are deterministic, resettable and labeled. Native/business TODOs are not passing acceptance.

Use actual subagents when available for disjoint contracts, UI, integration and independent QA. Otherwise perform those work packages sequentially and report that honestly. Freeze shared contracts and IDs first; keep config, dependency locks and shared styles under one owner.

## Build and delivery

Use the existing skill helpers copied into source, not a replacement build/import/ZIP format. After explicit dependency installation, run Vue/TS checks and the actual offline builder described in README.md. Build ../prototype.html from harness/prototype/main.ts and design/project.json. Bundle libraries, scoped CSS, icons, assets, synthetic fixtures and the exact export JSON; embed license notices and set the ready marker only after real Vue mount. A clean extraction must rebuild the artifact with no absolute links to its creator's checkout.

Deliver prototype.html, companion.project.json, independently buildable source/, design-brief.md, execution-prompt.md, README.md, INTEGRATION.md, integration-map.json, THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md and a finalized prototype.manifest.json. Add tests/prototype.journeys.mjs and actual evidence. The prepared manifest's null artifact hash and pending verification must be replaced only by measurements of a real built artifact. Do not claim image files exist unless actual authorized bytes are present. For selected boards, the translated rules in the brief are sufficient to start; disclose missing references.

## Verification

Run clean install, TypeScript/Vue checking, lint, architecture, code-line, maintainability and coverage gates without weakening thresholds. Test real local application actions, normal/empty/invalid/failure data, undo/cancel and baseline preservation. Run exact-artifact browser journeys, keyboard/focus, narrow/wide, light/dark, offline/no-network and denied-storage cases. Run actual Companion import/export and compiler plan/apply in disposable state, then generated-project build/typecheck/tests. Retain 400 source / 450 test code-line limits (excluding comments and blank lines), production coverage 90% lines/statements/functions and 85% branches, domain/application 95%/90%, and the existing analyzer rules.

Record exact commands, exit status, logs, source/model/artifact hashes and not-run limitations. Do not count TODO, skipped, blocked or failed checks as passed. Return actual artifacts and truthful build/integration instructions in this session; never promise future/background work. Native qualification and public release remain separate.

# {{title}} — prototype preparation

This package contains an agreed brief, an executable fresh-session prompt, a complete Companion project JSON and a real compiler-generated Vue/TypeScript clickdummy scaffold. It does not claim a finished or verified prototype.

Start by passing execution-prompt.md to an agent with this package available. Both Claude and Codex read the same canonical skill under source/.claude/skills/companion-prototype-design.

Import companion.project.json in Companion to continue visual authoring. Never import prototype-answers.json as a project.

## Build after implementation

Use the exact Node/npm versions in source/AGENTS.md and .nvmrc. Dependency installation is a separate explicit operation.

```sh
cd source
npm ci
npm run typecheck:clickdummy
node .claude/skills/companion-prototype-design/scripts/prototype.mjs build --repo . --entry harness/prototype/main.ts --project design/project.json --out ../prototype.html --title Prototype --execute
```

Existing output is preserved; choose a new filename or review the helper's explicit --replace option. A successful bundle is not browser/native/business acceptance. Follow the prompt's tests before finalizing the manifest or using the existing packaging helper.

## Reopen the guide

prototype-guide.json and prototype-answers.json capture the exact version used. `node bin/app prototype guide --json` discovers the current guide. `prototype validate --input <answers.json> --json` reports readiness without writes. Regenerate with the same current guide and a reviewed plan hash. Edited source files are protected by the maker receipt; resolve conflicts or choose another output folder.

# Integration

The Companion envelope is companion.project.json, mirrored in source/design/project.json. All generated pages, reusable component definitions/instances and interactions use the shared visual IR. Source-owned changes belong in the compiler's extension seams. See source/design/compiler-origins.json for actual generated source-to-design provenance and source/design/compiler-readiness.json for pending work.

A title-only action is an implementation TODO, not simulated business success. Do not claim arbitrary authored source can round-trip into JSON. Record unrepresentable source-owned behavior and native implementation work in the integration map.

For feature/improvement mode, baseline.project.json is the complete locally supplied baseline. Preserve it and the recorded source revision, compare stable IDs and run regression cases. This package is not automatically safe to merge into another repository. Local package creation grants no permission to publish potentially private baseline bytes.
